paragraphs: Job Morning, posted by Lily. On Friday, Teacher Kim had a Job Morning in the school hall. Three visitors came to tell us about their jobs. The hall was full, and we sat on the floor. Mia took the photos, and I wrote this page. Do you know these jobs?

A Mechanic and a Singer. The first visitor was a man in a blue work shirt. He is a mechanic, and he fixes cars and buses. He put a small engine on a table, and it was very loud. He showed us how it works with a long, thin tool. On Sunday, he is also a singer in a band. He sang a short song for us, and everybody clapped.

A Journalist and a Photographer. The second visitor was a woman with a big camera. She is a journalist, and she writes for a newspaper. Her newspaper comes out every morning. First she talks to people, and then she writes their stories. She is a photographer too, so she takes the photos for her stories. "A good photo tells a story," she said. Mia asked, "Which job do you like more?" "I like both, because I meet new people every day," said the woman.

An Artist and a Designer. The third visitor was a young woman with paint on her hands. She is an artist, and she paints big pictures of the sea. She is a designer too, and she makes posters for the town. First she draws with a pencil, and then she uses paint. She showed us a poster for the next music festival. "Can I be a designer?" asked Leo. "Yes, you can," she said. "You have already made many cartoons."
After the morning, Teacher Kim asked, "Which job do you want?" Leo wants to be a designer, and Mia wants to be a photographer. I have not decided yet. Which job do you want? Tell us in a message!
